meta.cdpNote: Performance.getMetrics returns cumulative counters; raw snapshots are recorded per window and all deltas are computed by this script.
meta.wsNote: WS frames classified by payload discriminator (MuxFrame/HostFrame type) and one level deeper for session/event - never by envelope type.
meta.usageNote: /usage/<method> is a real HTTP POST surface on the host origin (verified by recon), not an /api RPC path.
meta.confounderNote: The host is shared with a concurrently running agent session; ambient session/event traffic is measured as the closed-settings baseline and cannot be paused by this read-only probe.
